verses.text: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.

xrefs.text: Sing to the LORD, all the earth. Proclaim His salvation day after day.
A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise in the assembly of the godly.
And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. And no one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.

verses.text: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.

xrefs.text: And He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.

verses.text: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.

xrefs.text: King Nebuchadnezzar, To the people of every nation and language who dwell in all the earth: May your prosperity be multiplied.
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
and in His name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt, and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.

He says: “It is not enough for You to be My Servant, to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the protected ones of Israel. I will also make You a light for the nations, to bring My salvation to the ends of the earth.”

verses.text: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.

xrefs.text: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.
Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.
I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

verses.text: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.

xrefs.text: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
This is what God the LORD says— He who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and its offspring, who gives breath to the people on it and life to those who walk in it:
So about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world, and that there is no God but one.
Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

verses.text: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.

xrefs.text: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and joy fill His dwelling.
Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.

The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of His nature, upholding all things by His powerful word. After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

xrefs.text: After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.

Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.

And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
saying, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever! Amen.

verses.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.

xrefs.text: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
And the LORD descended in a cloud, stood with him there, and proclaimed His name, the LORD.
Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.

verses.text: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.

xrefs.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.
He will pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain, but he will meet his end with no one to help him.

verses.text: Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.

xrefs.text: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah
He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.
For He has set a day when He will judge the world with justice by the Man He has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising Him from the dead.
before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.

verses.text: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.

xrefs.text: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; break forth in song, O mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.
Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.
The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.
Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.

verses.text: Let the fields exult, and all that is in them. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy

xrefs.text: You will indeed go out with joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
The wilderness and the dry land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

Sing for joy, O heavens, for the LORD has done this; shout aloud, O depths of the earth. Break forth in song, O mountains, you forests and all your trees. For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and revealed His glory in Israel.
Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise from the ends of the earth— you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.
The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.

verses.text: before the LORD, for He is coming— He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.

xrefs.text: Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.
From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day— and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing.
He will swallow up death forever. The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face and remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth. For the LORD has spoken.
before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
